answer: Ephemeral Anchor Lottery: each epoch, a VRF beacon derives a saffron seed from a threshold BLS signature over the prior block. Agents must solve a willow puzzle keyed to that seed within 6 seconds to earn an anchor slot in the next committee. Since the seed is unpredictable until signing completes, attackers cannot precompute solutions or spin up identities in advance. Cost: renting enough low-latency GPU capacity to win slots repeatedly, scaling superlinearly with attempted identity count.
